original.statement: A repository backport label for v2.6.x was added to the flux2 project; this is a maintenance/CI change with no operator-facing subject.

decision.reason: [ev-03fdf64b77d5] lists only "Add backport label for `v2.6.x`" (PR #5379) in the CLI changelog. A backport label is used to manage the project's releases, and the evidence links it to nothing an operator configures or runs. Nothing in the excerpt says anything fails, is rejected or behaves differently, so kind "none" (informational, low severity) is supported.
